## How you tested it

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm e2e` pass

- [ ] Guide in `docs/guide/` and screenshots (`pnpm docs:shots`) updated, if the user sees the change
- [ ] Entry in `CHANGELOG.md`
